name: Sakuraba Karen
source:
The mother of [url=/c121752]Sakuraba Mayu[/url] and a housewife. She is very motherly and very close to her daughter. She and her husband have a good relationship, but they do not have an active night-life together due to his demanding schedule.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page06.html]official site[/url]]
